summary: First-finish smoke test of ApexTrade Pro (backend + frontend). All critical backend endpoints and the primary UI flow work end-to-end. No blockers.
passed: POST /api/auth/register creates user with starting_balance honored (75000 test) and returns token
GET /api/market/curated (stock/crypto/etf) -> 200 each returns 10+ items in {items:[...]} shape
POST /api/orders market BUY 2 AAPL -> filled, cash reduced correctly, position created
GET /api/portfolio shows position with market_value>0 and unrealized_pl field
SELL 1 reduces qty; SELL remaining closes/deletes position
Limit BUY AAPL at $10 (far below market) stored as status=open with limit_price=10; DELETE /api/orders/{id} cancels successfully
POST/GET/DELETE /api/watchlist for TSLA works; GET returns items with price + change_percent
Frontend /login renders and demo-login-btn signs in and lands on /
Dashboard renders Total Equity $100,000, Cash $100,000, STOCKS/CRYPTOS/ETFS movers, and live ticker; portfolio+curated API calls all 200
notes: Curated/ticker endpoints return {items:[...]} rather than a raw list; frontend consumes .items so this is consistent, but the review spec described a 'list' shape — flagging as informational only.
Initial dashboard render briefly shows $0.0000 in stat cards while /api/portfolio is in flight; resolves within ~2s. Not a blocker.
